heroHeadline: Pakistan Airlifts Weapons to Yemen as US Bolsters Gulf Air Defenses with Patriot Batteries
heroSubtitle: Pakistan dispatched four planeloads of weapons to the Saudi-backed Yemeni government, deepening its operational commitment to the anti-Houthi coalition. Simultaneously, the US is deploying additional Patriot missile defense batteries to Saudi Arabia and Qatar, reinforcing Gulf air defenses as Houthi cross-border attacks continue.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
